# Eye Vision Test Request

> A UK NHS–aligned **ophthalmic / optometric eye examination request (referral)** that a clinician completes to request an eye vision test for a patient. It records the requested test, the eye(s) to be examined, the clinical indication and specific question, relevant history, symptoms and red flags, and the requested urgency — then computes a **four-axis grading** (appropriateness, urgency / triage priority, request completeness, and clinical priority) plus a set of safety-critical flags. The output is a vetting report that supports the eye-care service's triage and booking decision.
